h1: Professional carpet cleaning needs a professional machine
intro: Carpet cleaning costs money, so you should get a professional clean for it. We only use professional grade carpet cleaning machines and professional grade cleaning liquids, with the right product for each kind of stain, in the hands of people we've trained.

understand.heading: A home carpet machine is not a professional clean
paragraphs: This is something that really annoys me. People buy a domestic carpet cleaning machine online, call it professional carpet cleaning and charge the same as a professional. It's disappointing, because the customer is paying for something they're not getting.

I'm not saying home machines are bad. If you want to keep your carpets fresh between cleans, it's good to have one at home. But a professional deep carpet clean can't be done with a domestic machine. It needs a professional grade machine.

The products matter just as much. A carpet cleaning product from the supermarket isn't going to help. Different stains need different professional products, and the person using them needs the training and experience to know which one.

different.heading: What's different when you book us

items.title: Professional grade machines only
items.text: We never use domestic carpet machines for a professional clean. Every carpet we clean is done with a professional grade machine.

items.title: The right machine for your property
items.text: We use three professional machines. The most powerful is for houses, where it can stay outside, and for big properties. The second is another professional grade machine. The third is smaller, for properties with a lot of stairs, and it's still powerful.

items.title: A product for each stain
items.text: Blood, coffee, oil and ink each need a different product. We carry professional grade carpet cleaning liquids and specific products for different stains.

items.title: Experience and training
items.text: A good machine is only part of it. Our own team is trained to use the machines and the products properly.

items.title: Our show up guarantee
items.text: We have systems in place so our cleaners arrive on the day and at the time you booked. If something outside our control happens, your clean is still done within 12 hours, or it's free.

items.title: Tell us within 24 hours
items.text: If anything isn't right after your carpet clean, tell us within 24 hours and we put it right.

promise.heading: Our promise to you
paragraphs: When you pay for a professional carpet clean, you get one: a professional grade machine, professional grade products and a cleaner trained to use them.

Our cleaners arrive on the day and at the time you booked. If something outside our control happens, your clean is still done within 12 hours, or it's free. And if anything isn't right, tell us within 24 hours and we put it right.

proof.heading: Carpets a landlord thought he'd have to replace
proof.paragraph: In Harold Wood, the tenants had left a property in a horrible condition. The landlord told us he thought he'd have to throw things away and change so many things in the flat, and asked us to do as much as we could. We deep cleaned the carpets and they looked like new again. He didn't have to replace anything, and the property was ready for new tenants.

faqs.question: How much does carpet cleaning cost?
faqs.answer: Carpet cleaning starts from £49. Your price depends on what you need cleaned, and you see it before you book.

faqs.question: Can a domestic carpet machine give a professional clean?
faqs.answer: No. Home machines you can buy online are fine for keeping your carpets fresh between cleans, but a professional deep carpet clean can only be done with a professional grade machine.

faqs.question: Is it worth having a carpet machine at home?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you want to keep up your carpets and clean them more often. It just isn't the same as a professional deep clean.

faqs.question: What machines do you use?
faqs.answer: Only professional grade carpet cleaning machines. We have three, so we can use the one that suits your property.

faqs.question: Why do you have three machines?
faqs.answer: Because properties are different. Our most powerful machine is for houses, where it can stay outside, and for big properties. The second is another professional grade machine. The third is smaller, for properties with a lot of stairs.

faqs.question: Can you clean carpets on stairs?
faqs.answer: Yes. We have a smaller professional machine just for properties with a lot of stairs. It's small, but it's still powerful and gets great results.

faqs.question: Can you clean carpets in a big house?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our most powerful machine is for houses and big properties.

faqs.question: What products do you use?
faqs.answer: Professional grade carpet cleaning liquids, plus specific products for different kinds of stains.

faqs.question: Can you treat stains like blood, coffee, oil or ink?
faqs.answer: Each of those needs a different product, and we carry professional products for each of them.

faqs.question: Can I just use a carpet product from the supermarket?
faqs.answer: For a deep clean, it isn't going to help. A professional result needs professional grade products used by someone who knows which one each stain needs.

faqs.question: Does experience matter for carpet cleaning?
faqs.answer: Very much. A good machine is only part of it. Training and experience are what get the most out of the machine and the products.

faqs.question: Can carpets that look ruined be saved?
faqs.answer: Often, yes. In Harold Wood, a landlord thought he'd have to replace things after the tenants left the property in a horrible condition. We deep cleaned the carpets and they looked like new again. He didn't have to replace anything.

faqs.question: Do you clean carpets at the end of a tenancy?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Harold Wood carpets were part of an end of tenancy clean, and the property was ready for new tenants afterwards.

faqs.question: Do you also clean mattresses and upholstery?
faqs.answer: Yes. We use the same professional machines and the same stain specific products for mattresses and upholstery.

faqs.question: Who will clean my carpets?
faqs.answer: Someone from our own trained, insured and DBS checked team. We never send random people.

faqs.question: What if I'm not happy with the clean?
faqs.answer: Tell us within 24 hours and we put it right.

faqs.question: What is your show up guarantee?
faqs.answer: We have systems in place so our cleaners arrive on the day and at the time you booked. If something outside our control happens, your clean is still done within 12 hours, or we do it for free.

faqs.question: What happens if something goes wrong on the day?
faqs.answer: We don't just cancel. We still handle your booking and get it done within 12 hours. If your clean was booked for the afternoon, for example, it would move to first thing the next morning.

faqs.question: How do you make sure your cleaners turn up?
faqs.answer: We check on our cleaners early in the morning and again late in the afternoon, so we know they're on track.
